name: Phuket weekend + Bangkok workweek (split plan)
notes: 2 nights Phuket (beach, Sat signature) then 4 nights Bangkok (all workdays, Dec 24 hub); one extra 1h30 flight on Sunday

name: Bangkok
notes: Urban river romance, no beach; densest work infrastructure; six nonstops to SAI on Dec 24; nonstops from SIN and HYD

name: Phuket
notes: Dry-season Andaman beaches; resort Wi-Fi unverified; Dec 24 needs 07:45 self-transfer via BKK unless FD612 runs Thursdays

name: Chiang Mai
notes: Dry, cool, cultural; no beach; Dec 24 only via BKK (EK370 21:10 arrival on Expedia)

name: Langkawi
notes: Rainforest-beach resorts; Dec showers; LGK to SAI two-stop only (6h45+)

name: Phang Nga Bay / Krabi
notes: Most romantic Andaman setting; island/limestone Wi-Fi and boat transfers; KBV to SAI 8h25 via BKK

name: Khao Lak
notes: Quiet, dry; thin luxury and dining; HKT plus 1-1.5h drive

name: Phu Quoc
notes: Calm west coast but APEC 2027 construction peaks Dec 2026; HYD access weak; Dec 24 via SGN

name: Siem Reap (work there)
notes: Zero Dec 24 travel, but duplicates the Phase 2 setting (screened out on trip-level duplication)

name: Koh Samui
notes: Screened out: tail of the Gulf monsoon in December

name: Bali
notes: Screened out: wet season, power-grid and remote-work enforcement risk, longest SAI connection

name: Luang Prabang
notes: Screened out: weak work infrastructure, awkward access from SIN/HYD

notes: Screened out: too many unknowns; KOS unreachable from SIN/HYD in under 24h on Expedia
